findings.summary: patch_() in gate.sh sends apply_patch as toolArgs {"input": <patch>}; neither the brief nor docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md names that key or that shape (Copilot may send the raw patch string), so a correct hook that reads the patch another way fails the apply_patch rows

notes: I ran every gate on the base. Each fails for the missing behaviour: unknown command fence (T1, T2, T9), no hooks file (T3), unknown key run.second-review (T4, T5, T6), no fence-audit.md (T7), no kit probe (T8). No gate takes more than 7 s. I also ran T4's doctor and run sections apart from its key checks: the fixture builds and doctor exits 0 with the old 'not fenced yet' warning, so T4 fails there on the new wording. Fix for T2: have patch_() send apply_patch in the way the brief supports, or make the gate send the patch both as an object field and as a raw string and require deny for each. Brief and docs do not say which one Copilot sends.
